subject: Azure Partner Center: Seller timezone handoffs & account mapping matrix
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, azure-partner-ops@microsoft.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Partner Center: initial timezone handoff proposal for Contoso

Team —

Following up from last week's intake, Contoso is expecting a rapid co-sell onboarding next quarter and they've asked for clear handoff windows so field sellers in EMEA and US don't overlap with Partner Center referrals. Attached is a first pass account matrix (AZPC_account_matrix_v2.xlsx) that maps accounts to primary seller, backup seller, and suggested handoff window.

Key asks:
- Confirm the timezone window strategy (proposed windows in attachment). I recommend 13:00-17:00 local seller time as the primary handshake window to maximize overlap with Contoso's ops team.
- Approve the mapping rules: prefer owner in HubSpot, then last-touch from AE, then market assignment.
- Identify any sensitive accounts that require a consent/entitlement check before we auto-assign.

I copied Microsoft Partner Ops for visibility on the Partner Center consent step (they will confirm if we can auto-claim).

Next steps: if we get agreement by EOD Wed, I'll publish the mapping and notify field sellers.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AZPC_account_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), handoff_windows.png (diagram)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, azure-partner-ops@microsoft.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: initial timezone handoff proposal for Contoso

Aisha —

Thanks for the clear proposal and the matrix. I reviewed the spreadsheet and added a few notes in the "handoff_notes" column:
- For accounts with global teams (AMER + EMEA), flag as "dual-owner" and schedule two 30-min overlap windows (EMEA morning + AMER late afternoon).
- For small accounts that are in HubSpot but inactive, use the Partner Center referral owner as the primary.

Two small asks from the field perspective:
1) Can we build a single calendar invite template that includes the Partner Center referral ID and suggested discovery checklist? That will reduce confusion during the handshake.
2) Please add time zone conversions for sellers in India (IST) — we have a few Contoso contacts based there.

I'll reach out to the EMEA seller leads to confirm availability once you publish.

-Vanessa
Director, Channel Programs
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 09:12 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message and attachments)

From: Julia Hoffman <julia.hoffman@contoso.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: azure-partner-ops@microsoft.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 07:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: initial timezone handoff proposal for Contoso

Hi Aisha / Vanessa —

Thank you, this looks helpful. A few clarifications from Contoso side:
- Our preferred overlap window for US sellers is 14:00-16:00 PT — that aligns better with our ops team in Redmond.
- For EMEA contacts, morning (09:30-11:00 CET) is best.
- For India (IST), our procurement lead is only available 04:00-06:00 PT which is tight; if that means a seller in APAC needs to be the owner, we are fine with that.

We also need the Partner Center referral ID included in any calendar invites and a short "what we need from Contoso in 15 minutes" checklist.

If you want, I can share a sample calendar invite from our side — would that help standardize?

Best,
Julia Hoffman
Senior Procurement Manager
Contoso

---
Forwarded attachment note: AZPC_account_matrix_v2.xlsx referenced. (I will supply an updated contact list by Friday.)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Julia Hoffman <julia.hoffman@contoso.com>, azure-partner-ops@microsoft.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: Seller timezone handoffs & account mapping matrix — final ops plan

All —

Brief update after consolidating feedback:
- Matrix updated (see AZPC_account_matrix_v2.xlsx v2). I marked dual-owner accounts and added IST conversions.
- Calendar invite template created (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aZPC-mapping-azpc-2026) and includes: Partner Center referral ID, 15-minute pre-call checklist, and HubSpot record link.
- Partner Ops confirmed we can auto-claim referrals for HubSpot-matched accounts, pending an explicit consent flag. Microsoft will write the consent flag back to the referral record.

Action items:
- Aisha: publish the mapping + notify field sellers (target: Monday 11/23).
- Vanessa: run a short 15-min training with EMEA seller leads (target: week of 11/30).
- Julia: send the updated Contoso contact list when available.

I'll keep this thread as the ops record — if anything else comes up, reply-all so we have the full audit trail.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AZPC_account_matrix_v2.xlsx (updated), handoff_windows.png (updated)
